Frequently Asked Questions

Clear answers with zero corporate runaround.

Will my data disappear if the developer shuts down or stops updating?

No. Noin is built on a 100% offline-first architecture. All records are stored directly inside a local SQLite database on your phone. Even if our app was removed from the store, your installed copy continues functioning forever. You can also export your raw CSV/JSON records at any time.

Can I track classic cars or motorcycles without a 17-digit VIN?

Yes! Unlike legacy corporate apps that enforce rigid VIN decoding, the VIN field in Noin is 100% optional. You can park pre-1981 classic cars, vintage hot rods, custom track cars, trailers, and motorcycles without errors.

Does Noin drain battery in the background?

No. Noin has zero continuous background GPS polling or telemetry listeners. Reminders are handled by Android's native system alarm framework once daily, consuming 0.0% noticeable battery.

Can I import my records from other apps?

Yes. Noin includes a standard CSV importer that maps date, odometer, service category, notes, and costs so you can migrate from spreadsheets or legacy trackers in seconds.

Noin Privacy Policy

100% On-Device Architecture • Zero Telemetry • Zero Data Brokers

✓ Zero-Knowledge Guarantee: Noin does not require account creation, does not collect telemetry, contains zero third-party advertising SDKs, and does not upload your records to any remote cloud.

1. Architecture & Core Principles

Noin is an Android mobile application engineered around a strict offline-first, zero-telemetry architecture. Unlike conventional automotive apps that require registration, store your driving habits in central cloud databases, or monetize via behavioural advertising networks, Noin operates autonomously on your smartphone.

The application has no centralized user database. We do not maintain servers that log your name, email address, IP address, vehicle identification numbers (VIN), or service histories.

2. Information We Store Locally on Your Device

All information you input is stored exclusively inside an encrypted local Room SQLite database in your device's isolated application sandbox (/data/data/com.noin.in/databases/):

  • Vehicle Attributes: Vehicle nickname, year, make, model, initial odometer reading, distance unit preference, and optional VIN.
  • Service & Maintenance Logs: Date of service, odometer reading at service, service category, cost amount in cents, part numbers, and user notes.
  • Fuel Fill-Up Records: Fuel volume in gallons/liters, total cost, odometer at pump, unit fuel price, and optional fuel station brand name.
  • Tire Tread Measurements: 4-point tire tread depth readings (Front-Left, Front-Right, Rear-Left, Rear-Right in 32nds of an inch or millimeters).
  • Pro Status Flag: A single boolean cryptographic token stored in Android SharedPreferences confirming Lifetime Pro or Flex subscription validity via Google Play Billing.

3. Information We Never Collect or Access

Data Category Collection Status Technical Explanation
GPS & Geolocation Zero Collection No location permissions (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) requested in AndroidManifest.xml.
Contact Lists & Address Books Zero Collection Noin does not inspect your device contacts or phonebook.
Camera & Media Files Local Only Receipt photos are selected strictly via Android Photo Picker and stored locally on your device filesystem.
Ad Identifiers (GAID / IDFA) Zero Collection Zero ad-monetization or tracking SDKs are compiled into the binary.
Analytics & Crash Tracking Zero Collection No Firebase Analytics, Mixpanel, Adjust, or third-party event trackers.

4. Third-Party Services & Payment Processing

When purchasing the optional Lifetime Multi-Bay upgrade ($19.99) or Flex subscription, the financial transaction is handled exclusively by Google Play Billing (Google LLC). Your credit card details, billing address, and financial tokens are processed by Google under the Google Privacy Policy. We never receive or store your payment details.

5. Your Data Control & Instant Deletion Rights

  • Universal Raw Export: Export your full maintenance ledger to universal .csv or .json format at any time with a single tap in Settings.
  • Resale Dossier Generation: Generate self-contained PDF documents directly on your device canvas without external API dependencies.
  • One-Tap Database Purge: The in-app Privacy Guarantee screen provides an immediate "Purge All Local Data" button that physically wipes all SQLite tables.
  • Application Uninstallation: Uninstalling Noin from your Android device permanently destroys all local SQLite files and attachments.

Knowledge Base & Support

Noin Help Center

Step-by-step guides, troubleshooting instructions, and direct support.

How do I transfer my records to a new Android phone?

Because Noin is 100% offline, records stay on your device. To transfer:
1. On your old phone, go to Settings / Privacy → Export Data (CSV / JSON).
2. Save the file to Google Drive or email it to yourself.
3. On your new phone, install Noin and tap Import Data. All bays and logs restore instantly.

How do I restore my Lifetime Pro purchase?

Ensure you are signed into the same Google Play account on your Android phone, open Noin, navigate to Garage → Unlock Pro, and tap "Restore Purchase". The app will immediately activate your Lifetime license.

Can I track classic cars or project vehicles without a 17-digit VIN?

Yes! VIN entry is 100% optional in Noin. Pre-1981 classic cars, vintage project trucks, motorcycles, trailers, and race cars are fully supported.

How does the 4-Corner Tire Tread Diagnostic work?

Under your vehicle bay, tap "+ Tread Check". Enter the tread depth for all 4 corners in 32nds of an inch. If the app detects an uneven variance greater than 3/32" across wheels, it automatically triggers a tire rotation recommendation.
